original: おっ、○○\nいいところに来たな！
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nYou're just in time!

original: 実はさ、頼みがあんだ。\nティアや師匠達にはナイショでさ
traducao: I actually have a favor to ask you.\nKeep it a secret from Tear and Van.

original: つってもまあ、難しい事じゃねえ。\n知られたら、まぁた周りが大騒ぎして\n変に面倒な事になっからよ
traducao: It's not a difficult thing to do.\nIf they find out, they'll make a fuss\nand it'll just be a pain.

original: ちょっくら、お忍びで外出っつーわけだ。\n……ってなわけ、で
traducao: I'm just going out incognito for a bit.\n...So, that's why,

original: ○○、お前も付き合え
traducao: ○○, you're coming with me.

original: 言っとくが、\nお前に選択権はないからな
traducao: Just so you know,\nyou don't have a choice in the matter.

original: いいか。\nこの事は絶っ対に誰にも言うなよ？\n詳しい事は、あ〜……適当にまた連絡すっから
traducao: Got it?\nDon't tell absolutely anyone about this.\nI'll... let you know the details later.

original: く〜っ。\nこれでちっとは、毎日\n退屈しないですみそうだぜ！
traducao: Man.\nThis will keep me from getting bored\nevery single day!

original: クエスト「ルーク様ご一行」が\nエントリーされました。\nルークから受ける事が出来ます
traducao: The quest 'Luke's Entourage' has been\nregistered.\nYou can accept it from Luke.

original: ったく、遅せーっつーの。\n日が暮れちまうかと思ったぜ
traducao: Geez, you're so slow.\nI thought the sun was going to set.

original: んじゃ、うるせー奴らに\n見つかる前に出発するぞ
traducao: Alright, let's head out before those\nnoisy guys find us.

original: だぁ〜〜〜っ！
traducao: Aaaargh!

original: 何だよ、この暑さ！\n暑くて焼け死ぬっつーの！！
traducao: What's with this heat!\nI'm gonna burn to death!!

original: クソッ！\nさっさと合流しねぇと……
traducao: Damn it!\nWe need to meet up with Guy quick...

original: おい、○○。\nモタモタすんなよ！
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nStop dragging your feet!

original: あ〜……。\nあちーな、くそっ……
traducao: Ah...\nIt's so hot, damn it...
This is so annoying!!

original: おい、○○。\n水！
traducao: Hey, ○○.\nGive me water!

original: 何、ボケーッとしてんだ。\n水だよ、水
traducao: Why are you just standing there?\nWater, I need water.

original: ……って、まさかお前。\n持ってきてねえとか\n言うんじゃねえだろうな？
traducao: ...Wait, don't tell me.\nYou didn't bring any water\nwith you?!

original: かーーっ、マジかよ！？\nありえねーっつーの！！
traducao: Gah, seriously!?\nThat's impossible!!

original: 砂漠だぞ砂漠！　水分補給は必須だろ？\nお前、俺に干からびて死ねっつーのか！
traducao: It's a desert! Water is essential!\nAre you trying to dry me up to death!?

original: 俺を誰だと思ってんだ、あぁ！？
traducao: Who do you think I am, huh!?

original: ……ちっ。\nしょうがねえ。\nあいつと合流すれば何とかなるだろ
traducao: ...Tch.\nWhatever.\nIt'll be fine once we meet up with Guy.

original: そういう部分は、いつも抜かりねえからな
traducao: Guy never slips up when it comes to that.

original: おい、もたもたすんなよ？\n遅れたら、お前の分の水はねーからな！
traducao: Hey, don't drag your feet!\nIf you're late, you won't get any water!

original: ああそれと、先に言っておくけどな。\nあいつに会っても、お前は軽々しく\n近付いたりするんじゃねーぞ
traducao: Oh, and I'll tell you this now.\nEven when we meet Guy, don't you dare\nget too close to him.

original: だーっ、めんどくせー！！\nいちいち説明を求めんな！
traducao: Gah, this is so annoying!!\nDon't ask me for an explanation!

original: とにかく、俺の言った通りに\nすればいいんだよ！
traducao: Anyway, just do exactly\nas I say!

original: おら、行くぞ！！
traducao: Come on, let's go!!

original: おっ。\nいたいた
traducao: Oh.\nThere he is.

original: おーい、ガイ！
traducao: Hey, Guy!

original: ルーク……か？
traducao: Luke... is that you?

original: お前、どうしてここに……
traducao: Why are you here...

original: ガイがこっちに向かってるって言うからさ。\n迎えに行ってやろうと思ってよ！\nへへっ
traducao: I heard Guy was heading this way.\nSo I thought I'd come meet you!\nHeheh.

original: という事は、また黙って\n抜け出して来たんだな？
traducao: So, you snuck out without telling anyone\nagain, didn't you?

original: 相変わらず無茶ばかりする……。\nええと……そちらは？
traducao: Always doing reckless things...\nUm... who is this?

original: あ？　○○か。\n俺が今、世話んなってる\nギルドの奴
traducao: Huh? This is ○○.\nSomeone from the guild\nI'm staying at.

original: ああ、あなたが。\nお話は伺っています
traducao: Ah, so it's you.\nI've heard about you.

original: 俺はガイ。\nファブレ家でお世話に\nなっている使用人です
traducao: I'm Guy.\nI'm a servant working for the\nFabre family.

original: よろしく
traducao: Nice to meet you.

original: だーっ。　ったく、挨拶なんかいいだろ！\nそれよりガイ、お前、水持ってないか？\n俺もう、喉がカラカラで
traducao: Gah. Enough with the greetings!\nMore importantly Guy, you got water?\nI'm so thirsty right now.

original: はいはい、ルーク坊ちゃん。\n水なら、このボトルの中に……
traducao: Yes, yes, Master Luke.\nIf it's water you need, it's in here...

original: おお、さすがガイ！\n水、水！！
traducao: Oh, just as expected of Guy!\nWater, water!!

original: ……っとと！
traducao: ...Whoops!

original: ああ……すまない。\n支えてくれて助かったよ、\n○○
traducao: Ah... sorry.\nThanks for helping me,\n○○.

original: ごくごく……ぷは〜っ。\n生き返ったぜ〜
traducao: *Gulp gulp* ...Phew.\nI'm alive again~

original: ははっ。\n全く……
traducao: Haha.\nGood grief...

original: さて、と。\nそれじゃ、ここからは俺も\nお供するとしましょうか
traducao: Well then.\nI guess I'll be joining you two\nfrom here on out.

original: ルークの世話は、とにかく\n手がかかるもので
traducao: Taking care of Luke is a handful,\nafter all.

original: なーんか言ったか？
traducao: Did you say something?

original: いいや、何も？
traducao: No, nothing at all.

original: ひっ。\nく、来るな！
traducao: Eek!\nD-Don't come any closer!

original: ああ、いや、違うんだ。\n君がどうというわけじゃ……
traducao: Ah, no, that's not it.\nIt's nothing against you...

original: あー……、だから言ったろ？\n近付くなって
traducao: Ah... see, I told you, right?\nNot to get too close.

original: こいつ、女嫌いなんだ
traducao: He's got a phobia of women.

original: 違うぞ、ルーク。\n俺は、女性は大好きだ
traducao: That's not true, Luke.\nI love women!

original: ただ、その……、\n少し、苦手なだけで
traducao: It's just, well...\nI'm a bit bad around them.

original: はいはい。\nそうでしたね、と
traducao: Yeah, yeah.\nWhatever you say.

original: ごくごく……ぷは〜っ。\n生き返ったぜ〜
traducao: *Gulp gulp* ...Phew.\nI'm alive again~

original: ははっ。\n呑気なもんだな、全く……
traducao: Haha.\nSo carefree, good grief...

original: さて、と。\nそれじゃ、ここからは俺も\nお供するとしましょうか
traducao: Well then.\nI guess I'll be joining you two\nfrom here on out.

original: ルークの世話は、とにかく\n手がかかるもので
traducao: Taking care of Luke is a handful,\nafter all.

original: なーんか言ったか？
traducao: Did you say something?

original: いいや、何も？
traducao: No, nothing at all.

original: は〜、やっと帰ってきたぜ。\nあやうく干からびて\n死ぬとこだったっつーの……
traducao: Phew, we're finally back.\nI almost dried up and\ndied out there...

original: ははは。\n確かに、ルーク坊ちゃんにとっては\n久しぶりの「冒険」だったな
traducao: Hahaha.\nIt certainly was a rare 'adventure'\nfor Master Luke.

original: 疲れたなら、\n先に部屋で休んでていいぞ。\n俺も後からすぐ行くから
traducao: If you're tired,\nyou can rest in your room first.\nI'll be right there.

original: ……そうすっか。\nんじゃ、後は適当に頼むわ
traducao: ...I'll do that.\nI'll leave the rest to you.

original: 迷惑をかけてすまなかったな。\nあいつ、ガッチガチの箱入りなもんで\nちょっとわがままが目立つと思うが……
traducao: Sorry for the trouble.\nLuke's very sheltered, so his selfishness\nmight stand out a bit...

original: 悪気はないんだ。\n目をつぶってやってくれ
traducao: He doesn't mean any harm.\nPlease just overlook it.

original: ……それにしても……、\nここは女性が多いんだな……
traducao: ...Even so...\nThere are a lot of women here...

original: ああいや、何でもない。\n気にしないでくれ。\nはは……
traducao: Ah, no, it's nothing.\nDon't worry about it.\nHaha...

original: それと……さっきは、その\nすまなかった。\n気を悪くしないでくれ
traducao: Also... about earlier,\nI'm sorry.\nPlease don't take it the wrong way.

original: まあ、とにかくだ。\nこれからここで厄介になる。\n一つ、よろしく頼むよ
traducao: Well, anyway.\nI'll be staying here from now on.\nI look forward to working with you.

original: ガイがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Guy joined Ad Libitum.
